remarks: Move right in and enjoy this charming 3-bedroom home, immediate occupancy and a quick closing. Whether you're looking to settle in before the school year begins or create your dream home with renovation potential and FAR opportunities, this property offers exceptional flexibility. Ideally located in one of Old Greenwich's most desirable neighborhoods, you'll love the convenience to schools, shops, restaurants, parks, and transportation. The inviting interior is complemented by a wonderful, private backyard--perfect for entertaining, play, or relaxing outdoors. A rare opportunity to own a sweet home in a fantastic community with endless possibilities.
